name: monster-shape-dragon-armor
description: An ordinary soldier wearing gold dragon mail or scales chooses the matching dragon under a polymorph wand. Carried but unworn gold mail retains arbitrary selection.

screenIncludes: The soldier removes a ring mail and puts on a gold dragon scale mail.
The soldier turns into a gold dragon!
screenExcludes: The soldier turns into an energy vortex!

screenIncludes: The soldier's set of gold dragon scales begins to shine brightly.
The soldier turns into a gold dragon!
screenExcludes: The soldier turns into a crocodile!

screenIncludes: The soldier picks up a gold dragon scale mail.
The soldier turns into a pit fiend!
screenExcludes: puts on a gold dragon scale mail
The soldier turns into a gold dragon!
